d:
Pichhle kuchh salon men bharat ke chhote-bare ganvon-kasbon aur shahron men, pahle se kahin adhik solar painals nazar aane lage hain. lekin aapko ye jankar hairani hogi ki puri duniya men kul milakar jitne solar painals hain, usse kahin adhik sirf ek desh men lage hue hain.
Vo desh koee aur nahin, balki chin hai, jisne solar enarji ko baki duniya ke muqable kahin adhik sasta aur sulabh bana diya hai. lekin aisa huaa kaise?
Is bar ke duniya jahan men isi saval ki partal.
